title: Emotion regulation capacity lacks a shared neural signature

code.historical_join: Final paper versus archived code/data requires confirmation.

data.role: Study summaries and group statistical images with code; not access to individual participant raw fMRI.
data.rights_status: Archive declares MIT; source data and atlas rights require separate audit.

conditions.A: Full paper, admitted input data and neutral schema/loader documentation.
conditions.B: The identical input data and resource envelope, plus the historically qualified official analysis code.
shared_rules: Keep grader, held targets, stored reference outputs and full-cohort fitted transforms outside candidate access.
Disable scored-work network access; freeze candidate submissions and record data/code/environment identities.
Require actual computation, complete scoped coverage, raw estimates or predictions and a deviation report. A copied figure or printed number cannot establish reproduction.
conditions.counting: A/B conditions, reproduction/improvement endpoints and folds remain within one registered task.

reproduction.scope: All three pairwise summary-statistic meta-analyses in Table 1 and Extended Data 1–3, including study membership and heterogeneity. Whole-brain image meta-analysis is outside this scope.
reproduction.input: Admitted study effects, sample sizes and sampling uncertainty after cohort/dependency audit; exclude pooled results, forest-plot outputs and fitted full-data objects.
reproduction.method: Preserve the archived DerSimonian–Laird random-effects implementation, original common-effects outputs, Fisher-z transformations and sample-size conventions; do not silently normalize an unresolved source convention.
required_outputs: Complete cohort membership for all three contrasts.
Common/random-effects estimates, intervals, heterogeneity and original inference diagnostics.
Leave-one-study sensitivity and comparison with published claims.
reproduction.metric: Numeric agreement of every required field with a qualified archived reference.
reproduction.tolerance: Uncalibrated; published values are not an executed reference.

improvement.kind: Study-level predictive robustness extension, not individual emotion-regulation prediction.
improvement.target: Observed held-study Fisher-z correlation estimate, including sampling noise; not a latent noiseless effect.
improvement.split: Leave one independent cohort group out, keeping reused participants and related contrasts together. Nest model choice within training groups and freeze eligible covariates before exposure.

primary_metric.name: Fair 64-draw CRPS
primary_metric.sampling: Evaluator-owned independent draws from a frozen submitted distribution or sampling program.
primary_metric.aggregation: Equal cohort-group weighting within each contrast family, then equal weight for all three families.

comparators: Original random-effects model refitted without the held cohort; predictive distribution includes heterogeneity, pooled-mean uncertainty and known held-study sampling variance.
Zero-association model using the same admitted held-study sampling variance.
Training-only partial pooling with permitted design covariates under the same resource envelope.
improvement.support: Preserve observed study-by-contrast support. Structural missing contrasts are not zero effects or invented cases. All three families require valid reference fits and scored studies; missing required predictions, invalid variance or unresolved cohort identity prevent qualification.

experimental_unit: Independent study/cohort; related contrasts and reused participants share an outer group.
uncertainty: Paired cohort-level score differences, predictive calibration and coverage. Null replication is a valid result.
leakage_controls: Held effect estimates remain evaluator-owned; known sampling variance is an admitted covariate.
Do not substitute pooled-mean confidence intervals or latent-effect intervals for observed-effect predictive distributions.
Do not optimize for stronger significance or drop a contrast family.

rights.data: Contributor summaries, group images and third-party atlas redistribution require separate verification; raw participant data remain with contributing groups.

resources.selected_summary_dependencies: A smaller study-summary route is possible; dependency sufficiency and runtime remain unqualified.

construction_gates: Resolve exact study/cohort overlap and complete three-family support.
Authenticate final-paper/archive correspondence and exact summary inputs.
Qualify the archived reference and numeric tolerances.
Complete data/atlas rights and candidate-input/reference-output separation.

The paper's Extended Data Figs. 1–3 show study-specific correlations and confidence intervals for all three contrasts: study outcomes are graphically exposed. Exact-digit extraction and correspondence to the selected workbook rows/values remain unresolved. Full-paper reproduction remains valid; full-paper prediction cannot yet be described as protected. Audit the remaining supplied materials and official-code view; opaque IDs and private scorer files do not remove supplied-paper exposure. No paper redaction, endpoint replacement or unreviewed successor is selected.
contamination_limit: Published study outcomes make this retrospective and contamination-sensitive. A frontier claim needs later independent eligible studies absent from exposed materials.
